title: Phase 1: freeze M0-T036 supervisor behavior identity + defect-only maintenance lane (AD-065)
objective: Record the frozen behavior identity of the accepted shadow-only supervisor (merged main SHA, supervisor tree identity, test-suite baseline) and establish the defect-only maintenance lane: no supervisor feature additions unrelated to D-010 requirements or reproduced defects (Section 18 Phase 1; AD-065; 0A.10).
business_reason: D-010 Phase 1 requires finishing and freezing the current supervisor before further work; M0-T036 is accepted+merged, so the remaining Phase 1 scope is the freeze record and maintenance-lane rule.
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): the freeze record pins the accepted supervisor identity - merged main SHA, git tree hash of tools/agent_supervisor/ at that SHA, and the passing test-suite baseline - and each value reproduces via the exact git/pytest commands recorded in the report.

AS-2 (executable): .claude/rules/supervisor-freeze.md states the defect-only maintenance lane using the AD-093 qualifying-evidence list verbatim and requires every future supervisor task to cite its evidence.
AS-3 (executable): registry validator and control-plane test suite green at the frozen head; the rule change is itself reviewed under the governance gates (G3/G5).
risks: Freeze must not block the defect lane (M0-T041 depends on it being explicitly carved out).
